listing.name: Skylanders Giants — tsapZ GiantsRecomp (tsapZ)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Firstlevelplays; latergame/Battle mode has not been tested;installation on a clean machine has not been tested. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own North American Xbox 360 ISO or extracted folder with the region-free executable for title 415608DA. The accepted default.xex fingerprint is 12d1e29e4f07fbc559bc1a4988dd6bf346c3d16e30cbf862e2683e862f9fc09e.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release installer and import your own ISO. Games run as standalone native programs. The CoreOfLight hub and a real USB portal are optional; a virtual portal is supported. The Windows x64 player uses D3D12. Building from source requires VS2022 Clang, CMake, Ninja, just and Python.

warnings: Firstlevelplays; latergame/Battle mode has not been tested;installation on a clean machine has not been tested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
